paired.timing_scope: Same process, identical quantized rows and parameters; serial fits, alternating reference/native order after one warmup each. Copies/conversions excluded. Native validation and fitting allocations included. Uncontrolled desktop.
limits: Pure fitting only; no native sampling or automatic selection promotion.
Quantized sample copies/conversion are outside both fit timers.
Native validation and fitting allocations are inside its timer.
Managed peak is measured in a separate native warmup; excludes caller sample columns, old output and allocator overhead.
Warmups and measured fits use the same pinned expected tree on every call.
Scalar portability checks are separate; paired timings use AArch64 NEON on an uncontrolled desktop.

scope: Validation-only execution change. Repeated timings cover 64 stock-reference spline fits, including the previous 19 outliers. Full 233-fit replay supplies correctness and storage evidence; no new repeated full-corpus timing or complete-learning speedup claim.
